en: Black-and-white postcard view of a manor-like castle building with a tall, narrow tower and steep tiled roof, surrounded by trees and a fenced garden. In the foreground is a dirt road with a horse and carriage and a driver, and a smaller outbuilding with a large arched door on the right. Printed German text at the top left identifies the place as Schloss Zottewitz near Priestewitz.
